pages.text:
春天的早晨，幼儿园门口的花开得正好。
咘咘背着小书包，蹦蹦跳跳地走进大门。她没有哭，甚至还朝爸爸妈妈挥挥手：「拜拜！」
NOMI 骄傲地说：「咘咘现在每天都不哭了呢！」
NONO 站在咘咘的书包上拍拍翅膀：「了不起！」
pages.text_en:
On a spring morning, flowers bloomed at the kindergarten gate.
Bubu bounced through the door with her little backpack. She didn't cry — she even waved at Mom and Dad: "Bye-bye!"
NOMI said proudly: "Bubu doesn't cry at all anymore!"
NONO flapped his wings from atop Bubu's backpack: "Amazing!"

pages.text:
可是，上课的时候，咘咘有一个小小的问题。
艳艳老师站在黑板前面讲故事，小朋友们都安静地坐着。
只有咘咘——扭一下，动一下，椅子发出「吱嘎吱嘎」的声音。
pages.text_en:
But during class, Bubu had a little problem.
Teacher Yanyan stood at the blackboard telling a story. All the children sat quietly.
All except Bubu — she wiggled and squirmed, her chair going creak-creak-creak.

pages.text:
咘咘的小脚晃来晃去，左看看，右看看。
她拉拉小熊同学的袖子，又摸摸自己的耳朵，还站起来看看窗外的小鸟。
艳艳老师温柔地说：「咘咘，请坐好哦。」
pages.text_en:
Bubu's little feet swung back and forth. She looked left, looked right.
She tugged at Bear's sleeve, then touched her own ears, then stood up to watch birds outside.
Teacher Yanyan said gently: "Bubu, please sit down."

pages.text:
咘咘坐下来了，可是没过一会儿，她又开始扭来扭去。
小狗同学看了她一眼，小声说：「嘘，老师在讲话。」
咘咘红了红脸，小声说：「可是……坐着好难呀。」
pages.text_en:
Bubu sat down, but before long she was wiggling again.
Corgi glanced at her and whispered: "Shh, teacher is talking."
Bubu blushed and whispered back: "But... sitting still is so hard."

pages.text:
下课后，NOMI 走过来拉着咘咘的手。
「咘咘，你知道大树是怎么站得稳稳的吗？」
咘咘歪着头想了想：「因为……大树有根？」
NOMI 笑了：「对呀！坐在椅子上的时候，想象自己是一棵小树，小脚就是树根，牢牢地踩在地上。」
pages.text_en:
After class, NOMI came over and held Bubu's hand.
"Bubu, do you know how a big tree stands so steady?"
Bubu tilted her head: "Because... trees have roots?"
NOMI smiled: "Exactly! When you sit in your chair, imagine you're a little tree. Your feet are the roots, planted firmly on the ground."

pages.text:
NONO 飞到咘咘头顶，展开红色的小翅膀说：
「还有还有！你的小手放在膝盖上，就像树枝安安静静地垂着。」
咘咘试了试，把小脚平平地放在地上，小手放在膝盖上。
「这样吗？」
「完美！」NOMI 和 NONO 一起说。
pages.text_en:
NONO flew to the top of Bubu's head and spread his little red wings:
"And also! Put your hands on your knees, like branches hanging quietly."
Bubu tried it — she placed her feet flat on the ground and her hands on her knees.
"Like this?"
"Perfect!" NOMI and NONO said together.

pages.text:
下午上课了。艳艳老师拿出一盒彩色卡片，教小朋友们认识形状。
咘咘坐在椅子上，心里默默念着：「我是小树，我是小树……」
她的小脚牢牢踩着地面，手放在膝盖上。
一秒、两秒、三秒……咘咘没有动！
pages.text_en:
Afternoon class began. Teacher Yanyan brought out colorful shape cards.
Bubu sat in her chair, silently telling herself: "I'm a little tree, I'm a little tree..."
Her feet stayed firmly on the ground, hands on her knees.
One second, two seconds, three... Bubu didn't move!

pages.text:
过了一会儿，咘咘的脚又开始痒痒的，想要晃一晃。
她偷偷看了一眼 NOMI，NOMI 对她竖起了大拇指。
咘咘深吸一口气，把注意力放回艳艳老师的卡片上。
「三角形有三条边……」咘咘跟着老师一起说。
pages.text_en:
After a while, Bubu's feet got itchy and wanted to swing.
She sneaked a peek at NOMI, who gave her a thumbs-up.
Bubu took a deep breath and turned her attention back to Teacher Yanyan's cards.
"A triangle has three sides..." Bubu repeated with the teacher.

pages.text:
整整一节课，咘咘都坐得好好的！
艳艳老师讲完最后一张卡片，笑着看向大家：「今天谁坐得最好呀？」
小朋友们齐声喊：「咘咘！」
咘咘的长耳朵一下子竖得高高的，脸蛋红扑扑的。
pages.text_en:
For the entire class, Bubu sat perfectly still!
When Teacher Yanyan finished the last card, she smiled at everyone: "Who sat the best today?"
All the children shouted: "Bubu!"
Bubu's long ears shot straight up, her cheeks turning rosy.

pages.text:
艳艳老师走过来，在咘咘的手背上贴了一颗金色小星星。
「咘咘今天进步特别大，坐得像小树一样稳。老师为你骄傲！」
咘咘看着手背上闪闪发亮的星星，开心地笑了。
pages.text_en:
Teacher Yanyan walked over and placed a golden star sticker on the back of Bubu's hand.
"Bubu made wonderful progress today — sitting steady as a little tree. Teacher is so proud of you!"
Bubu looked at the sparkling star on her hand and beamed with joy.

pages.text:
放学了，爸爸妈妈来接咘咘。
咘咘举着手背跑过去：「爸爸妈妈快看！咘咘得了小星星！」
妈妈蹲下来抱住她：「咘咘真厉害，又不哭又坐得好！」
爸爸摸摸她的耳朵：「咘咘是最棒的小朋友。」
pages.text_en:
School was over. Mom and Dad came to pick up Bubu.
Bubu ran to them, holding up her hand: "Mom, Dad, look! Bubu got a star!"
Mom knelt down and hugged her: "Bubu is amazing — no crying AND sitting so well!"
Dad patted her ears: "Bubu is the best kid ever."

pages.text:
回家的路上，NOMI 牵着咘咘的手，NONO 在头顶飞来飞去。
咘咘抬头看着天空说：「明天咘咘还要当小树！」
NOMI 笑着说：「那你一定是全幼儿园最漂亮的小树。」
NONO 拍着翅膀唱：「小树小树，坐得住～」
pages.text_en:
On the way home, NOMI held Bubu's hand while NONO flew above.
Bubu looked up at the sky: "Tomorrow Bubu will be a little tree again!"
NOMI smiled: "Then you'll be the prettiest little tree in the whole kindergarten."
NONO flapped and sang: "Little tree, little tree, sitting free~"

pages.text:
晚上，咘咘躺在床上，手背上的小星星在月光下闪闪发光。
她闭上眼睛，梦见自己变成了一棵开满粉色花朵的小树，在教室里稳稳地站着。
NOMI 和 NONO 变成了树上的浣熊和小鸟，陪她一起安安静静地，等待下一个美好的明天。

晚安，咘咘。🌙
pages.text_en:
At night, Bubu lay in bed. The little star on her hand sparkled in the moonlight.
She closed her eyes and dreamed she became a little tree covered in pink blossoms, standing steady in the classroom.
NOMI and NONO became a raccoon and a bird in the tree, keeping her company, quietly waiting for another beautiful tomorrow.

Goodnight, Bubu. 🌙

pages.text:
第二天早上，咘咘又蹦蹦跳跳地走进幼儿园。
她一坐到小椅子上，就把小脚踩好、小手放好。
艳艳老师笑着说：「咘咘，你今天又是小树了呀？」
咘咘骄傲地点点头：「是的！咘咘是坐得最好的小树！」

— 全剧终 —
pages.text_en:
The next morning, Bubu bounced into kindergarten again.
As soon as she sat in her little chair, she planted her feet and placed her hands just right.
Teacher Yanyan smiled: "Bubu, are you a little tree again today?"
Bubu nodded proudly: "Yes! Bubu is the best-sitting little tree!"

— The End —
